# ponte_agents (Data Source)

The agents that carry every one of the given labels, for for_each over memberships or bindings. No labels means every agent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Active agents carrying both labels.
data "ponte_agents" "prod_claims" {
  labels = { team = "claims", env = "prod" }
}

output "prod_claims_agents" {
  value = data.ponte_agents.prod_claims.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `labels` (Map of String) Label = value pairs an agent must all carry.
- `status` (String) Only agents in this status. Defaults to active; set to "any" for all.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ids` (List of String) The matching agent ids, sorted.
- `names` (Map of String) Agent id to display name.
